title: Elution kinetics, antimicrobial efficacy, and degradation and microvasculature of a new gentamicin-loaded collagen fleece. Kilian O., Hossain H., Flesch I., Sommer U., Nolting H., Chakraborty T., Schnettler R.; 2009
authors: J Biomed Mater Res B Appl Biomater.; 90(1):210-22. * Jason® fleece G
supports: Pre-clinical study from the botiss collacone / collafleece (collagen cone and fleece) literature list — the product featured in it, which is not the same as the study being about the product, so check the design and the comparator before citing it as product evidence. Authors' conclusion, verbatim: “Here, we show that the new, pH -neutral, gentamicin -containing fleece Jason G exhibits good overall antimicrobial effectiveness against both gram -positive and gram -negative bacteria in vitro with improved degradation properties and microvasculature formation in vivo. 14” This records what the paper says, not what a rep may say: the sales wording still has to pass the claim tiers, and a study in one indication licenses nothing in another.
